impact:
Reported from real use: "when swapping a workout, I want to be able to search all workouts or even create one. Right now I can only pick a suggested this is annoying."

WHERE THE DEFECT IS
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:520-545 — the swap panel renders exactly one list: the response of GET /api/exercises/:id/alternatives. There is no query input and no create row.
- apps/api/src/exercise-alternatives.ts:4 — ALTERNATIVES_LIMIT caps that list at 12, and apps/api/src/routes/exercises.ts:102-146 restricts it to the SAME primary muscle group. So the reachable set mid-workout is "up to 12 same-muscle names", and nothing else in the library or the 65-entry catalog can be reached at all.
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:278 — `canSwap` requires `primaryMuscleGroup != null`, so for an untagged exercise the Swap button is never rendered.
- apps/api/src/routes/exercises.ts:112 — an untagged source returns [] by design, which the panel renders as "No alternatives for this one" (SessionScreen.tsx:527). That is a dead end with no escape.

THE SEPARATE ADD PANEL IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE
apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:827-870 has "＋ Add an exercise", which does reach the whole library and can create. It is not the same thing, for three reasons: it ADDS alongside the exercise being replaced rather than standing in for it; it renders `library.map(...)` unfiltered as chips (:836-845), so past a screenful the rest is unreachable by browsing — the exact defect ISS-008 fixed in the builder; and its create field (:847-866) is a bare name input with a kind selector, i.e. the type-exact create that ISS-008 replaced.

THE WORKING COUNTER-EXAMPLE IS IN THIS REPO, AND IS THREE COMMITS OLD
ISS-008 (cd09902) built exactly this for the program builder: apps/web/src/screens/program/ExercisePicker.tsx over apps/web/src/lib/exercise-pick.ts, which searches the library and the catalog as one ranked list with an explicit "Create <typed>" row, and apps/web/src/screens/program/ProgramScreen.tsx renders the alternatives list with that picker BELOW it as the "something else" escape. The session screen — where the choice is made under time pressure, mid-set — has only the alternatives half.

VERIFIED vs SUSPECTED
Verified by reading, and by driving the running app in a browser: the session swap panel lists alternatives only (5 shown for Back Squat, ranked library-then-catalog with NEW badges) and carries no input element. Verified that the program builder's equivalent panel does carry one. Not verified at runtime: the untagged-exercise dead end, which is read from `canSwap` and the endpoint's null-muscle-group branch rather than reproduced.

PROPOSED FIX
Render ExercisePicker inside the session swap panel, below the alternatives, exactly as ProgramScreen does — same component, same lib, no new concepts. Then drop the `canSwap` tag requirement: with a picker present, an untagged exercise has somewhere to go, so the button should appear and the panel should show the picker with a note instead of "No alternatives for this one".

Note the existing design decision this must not disturb: SessionScreen.tsx:302-305 states a substitute is performed-side only — it joins the session as an ad-hoc exercise and the program day keeps what it planned. This issue does not change that. See ISS-012 for what that costs the user once the swap has happened.
resolution:
The session swap panel now renders the program builder's ExercisePicker below the suggested alternatives, exactly as ProgramScreen does — same component, same lib, no new concepts.

- `ExercisePicker` moved from `screens/program/` to `components/ExercisePicker.tsx`, since two screens now use it.
- `pickFromAlternative` moved into `lib/exercise-pick.ts`; ProgramScreen imports it from there rather than declaring its own copy. One mapping from `ExerciseAlternative` to `ExercisePick`, in one place.
- `SessionScreen.swapTo` now takes an `ExercisePick` rather than an `ExerciseAlternative`, so the alternatives list and the picker land in the same handler. A library pick already in the session focuses it; a catalog pick posts the name with no `kind` so the server resolves kind and tags from the catalog entry; a `new` pick posts name + kind.
- `canSwap` no longer requires `primaryMuscleGroup != null`. With a picker present, an untagged exercise has somewhere to go, so the Swap button renders for every active exercise and the empty state reads "No same-muscle alternatives — search below" instead of the old dead end "No alternatives for this one".
- The picker excludes nothing (`NO_EXCLUSIONS`): an exercise already in the session is a legitimate substitute, and picking it moves focus onto it.

The performed-side-only design decision is untouched: a substitute still joins the session as an ad-hoc exercise and the program day keeps what it planned.

Out of scope, filed as ISS-013: the separate "Add an exercise" panel still browses unfiltered chips and creates by bare name. It was not folded into the picker because the picker's KIND_OPTIONS has no `distance`, and a freeform session is exactly where a ride gets logged.

Verified: `pnpm --filter @afya/web typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm --filter @afya/api test` (35 passed) all clean. Not verified at runtime.
title: Mid-workout swap can only pick a suggested alternative: no search, no create, and nothing at all for an untagged exercise
